Plan order: (1) str0m bind/advertise config seam [the real work], (2) compose sovereign+UDP mapping, (3) Keto view seed, (4) Dagger decode job → framesDecoded>0, (5) flip-or-reaffirm, (6) G4 carried. Flip stays conditional on a real G2 pass. Open Qs: advertised-IP + UDP-port strategy; split GAP-1 if larger than a phase.
